_comment: What each example shows, for the Shows column of examples/README.md. examples-index.ts fails when an example directory has no entry here. The Scripted and Newest live run columns come from runs/, not from this file.
aider: Aider (a terminal coding tool) through plugboard's OpenAI-compatible endpoint. A runner checks one message on three models
anythingllm: AnythingLLM in Docker with the Generic OpenAI provider's env vars
async-openai: async-openai (Rust) with a text call, a stream and one tool round trip. Run with `cargo run`; passes against plugboard
autogen: AutoGen (autogen 0.14.1, the classic `config_list` API) with a text call, a stream and a two-agent tool round. A PEP 723 script, run with `uv run`; passes on the OpenAI route, Anthropic route not run
claude-code: Claude Code through `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`: shell exports and a `settings.json` `env` block
codex-cli: Codex CLI through a custom `responses` provider: a `config.toml`
continue: Continue `config.yaml` with one plugboard model on Chat Completions and one on Responses
crewai: CrewAI with a text call, a stream and a crew task that calls one tool. A PEP 723 script, run with `uv run`; passes against plugboard
curl: One request per API in plain shell: chat, responses, Anthropic Messages, Gemini, legacy completions and models
dspy: DSPy (through its LiteLLM route, `openai/` prefix): a Predict and a ChainOfThought on one question, and a typed output
go-openai: go-openai (Go) with a text call, a stream and one tool round trip. Run with `go run .`; passes against plugboard
haystack: Haystack `OpenAIChatGenerator` in a two-component pipeline, with streaming and a tool round trip. A PEP 723 script
instructor: Instructor extracting a validated Pydantic object, in TOOLS mode, JSON_SCHEMA mode and as a partial stream
jan: Jan Agent: a `jan config set` script for the OpenAI-compatible route, and a per-project `agent.toml.example`
kilo-code: Kilo Code CLI provider block for plugboard's Chat Completions route
langchain-js: LangChain JS (`@langchain/openai`): the same scenarios, with a `chat` and an `auto` variant
langchain-python: LangChain (`langchain-openai`'s `ChatOpenAI`): chat, tools, streaming, images, structured output, models and the error paths, on Chat Completions and on the Responses API
langfuse: Langfuse's OpenAI wrapper (`from langfuse.openai import OpenAI`) with a text call, a stream and one tool round trip. A PEP 723 script, run with `uv run`; passes against plugboard with tracing off
librechat: LibreChat custom endpoints for plugboard, OpenAI and Anthropic shapes: `librechat.yaml`, a compose override and `.env`
litellm-client: LiteLLM's `completion()` with the `openai/` prefix: a completion, a stream, a tool round trip and structured output
llamaindex: LlamaIndex `OpenAILike` against plugboard: text, stream and a tool round trip. A PEP 723 script
lobechat: LobeChat in Docker: `OPENAI_PROXY_URL` and the model list, in a compose file and `.env.example`
mastra: Mastra agent with one tool, using the `plugboard/fast` model object. Run with bun after `npm i @mastra/core zod`
n8n: n8n in Docker, driven headless through webhooks: S1 to S7; workflows in `workflows/`
open-webui: Open WebUI in Docker, pointed at plugboard on the host, with the plugboard options it needs; driven over its HTTP API
openai-agents: The OpenAI Agents SDK on the Responses API and on Chat Completions: text, stream, tool and structured output. Run with `uv run`
openai-agents-js: The OpenAI Agents SDK for JavaScript on the Responses API: text, stream, tool and structured output. Run with `bun`
openai-dotnet: The official OpenAI .NET library with a text call, a stream and one tool round trip. Run with `dotnet run`; passes against plugboard
openai-js: The OpenAI JS SDK: the same scenarios in TypeScript, on Chat Completions and on the Responses API
openai-python: The OpenAI Python SDK: chat, tools, streaming, images, structured output, models and the error paths, on Chat Completions and on the Responses API
promptfoo: promptfoo config: `openai:chat:fast` with plugboard's base URL, a text check and a tool-call check
pydantic-ai: pydantic-ai (`OpenAIChatModel`, Chat Completions): chat, tools, streaming, images, structured output and the error paths
self-hosted: Self-hosted apps configured by env or compose: Karakeep, Frigate (`config.yml`), paperless-gpt, paperless-ai (`.env` and compose), PR-Agent (`.env`), SiYuan (`.env` and compose). Page per app in docs/self-hosted
semantic-kernel: Semantic Kernel (Python) with a text call, a stream and a plugin call through automatic function calling. A PEP 723 script, run with `uv run`; passes against plugboard
sillytavern: SillyTavern in Docker; the plugboard endpoint and key are set in its UI
smolagents: smolagents `OpenAIModel` with text, streaming and a `ToolCallingAgent`. A PEP 723 script (needs `smolagents[openai]`)
tool-bot: The tool-call round trip: plugboard returns `tool_calls`, your code runs the tool and sends the result back. Bun and the `openai` SDK, about 50 lines
vercel-ai-sdk: The Vercel AI SDK (`ai` 7) through its three ways in: `createOpenAICompatible`, `openai.chat(id)` and `openai(id)` on `/v1/responses`. Chat, tools, streaming, structured output, images, models and errors
zed: Zed `settings.json` for an OpenAI-compatible and an Anthropic-compatible provider
